items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Eddie Anderson and I used to go to the fights every Tuesday night at the Olympic with him

ctx.x: So they hired me, you know, he talked to my dad, and I go to work, and Rochester used to take me to the fights -- Eddie Anderson and I used to go to the fights every Tuesday night at the Olympic with him, and then we'd come to do the show. And my dad liked Eddie, so he would let me go to the fights with him.
But I did tell you that Ivy Anderson was in the show, that was before she joined Duke.
